title_or_table: Schedule B disbursements of each nominee’s joint fundraising committee to other committees, aggregated by recipient
universe_or_base: For each major-party nominee, the joint fundraising committee that transferred the most to the nominee’s principal campaign committee in the 2024 cycle, and every committee it paid
vintage: FEC processed filings as the API served them on November 12, 2026
qualification: Amounts are the FEC’s sums of itemized disbursements to each committee in the cycle; a joint fundraising committee splits contributions among its participants under its agreement, so a transfer is not a gift from the committee’s own funds. Each nominee had more than one joint fundraising committee; the rule above picks one for each, read the same way.

jfc_id.description: FEC ID of the joint fundraising committee

recipient_id.description: FEC ID of the committee paid

recipient_name.description: its name as the FEC gives it today

schedule_b_lines.description: Schedule B lines the itemized rows use

is_nominee_campaign.description: yes for the nominee’s principal campaign committee

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Election Commission, Schedule B disbursements of the Harris Victory Fund and the Trump National Committee JFC, 2023 to 2024 cycle, United States. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Each is the nominee’s joint fundraising committee that sent the most to the campaign.
